verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own bulk actions: fetching all repositories and merging every updated repository with a single tap, plus a Resolve tool that handles conflicts in many files at once. These are limited to specific git operations rather than a general bulk-operation capability. missing for 10: general-purpose bulk actions (multi-select commit, delete, tag or push across many items), documented bulk or batch support in the automation surface (x-callback-url, Shortcuts, Repository Agent), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can pull the list of repositories down to Fetch for all your repositories. If any of your repositories received new commits you will be able to Merge all these repositories with a single tap.
A faster solution is to use the Resolve tool that lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once.
